snippet.title: ReDrop [Official Gameplay Trailer]
snippet.description:
ReDrop on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783370/ReDrop/

DIE. REDROP. REPEAT.

Welcome to ReDrop, the pixel-art precision platformer where every death leaves a platform behind, and your mistakes become the only way forward.

In this brutal, no-mercy rage game, you’ll climb your failures, dodge death (or don’t), and suffer gloriously through unforgiving traps, pixel-perfect jumps, and chaotic platform stacking.

Think you’ve got what it takes?
Get gud. Or get wrecked.

💀 Open world exploration
💀 Multiple endings
💀 Speedrun-friendly timers
💀 Pure pain, pixel by pixel

Try the demo now and buy the game the 26th of June!

Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again. Then cry. Then try again.

ReDrop on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783370/ReDrop/
